.github/workflows/stage-6459-wp0-gates.y.content:
name: Stage 6.4.5.9 WP0 Architecture Gates

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - stage/6.4.5.9-architecture-closure
      - rebuild/windows-release-closure-*
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  IMPLEMENTATION_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
  BASELINE_ANCHOR_COMMIT: 570823e722f6db475066d6ef80ba900ac5c6cb39
  BASELINE_ANCHOR_PATH: governance/rejected-baselines/stage-6.4.5.8.json
  BASELINE_ANCHOR_BLOB: 6a5ffc68e76baf6a477668c6c2faf61934e94720

jobs:
  wp0-route:
    name: wp0-route
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 6
    outputs:
      route: ${{ steps.route.outputs.route }}
      base: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base }}
      head: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pull-request merge or pushed branch history
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Resolve exact event diff range
        id: range
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PULL_REQUEST_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PULL_REQUEST_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PUSH_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}
          PUSH_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${EVENT_NAME}" in
            pull_request)
              BASE_SHA="${PULL_REQUEST_BASE_SHA}"
              HEAD_SHA="${PULL_REQUEST_HEAD_SHA}"
              ;;
            push)
              BASE_SHA="${PUSH_BASE_SHA}"
              HEAD_SHA="${PUSH_HEAD_SHA}"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "unsupported WP0 event: ${EVENT_NAME}" >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          [[ "${BASE_SHA}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "${HEAD_SHA}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "${BASE_SHA}" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
          git cat-file -e "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}"
          git cat-file -e "${HEAD_SHA}^{commit}"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "${BASE_SHA}" "${HEAD_SHA}"
          printf 'base=%s\n' "${BASE_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'head=%s\n' "${HEAD_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Establish exact base-owned route policy
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base }}
          TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/yance-wp0-trusted-route
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}"
          mkdir -p "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}"
          git archive --format=tar "${BASE_SHA}" -- \
            tools/layered-ci/select-wp0-route.js \
            tools/layered-ci/wp0-routing.js \
            tools/layered-ci/cli-support.js \
            governance/layered-ci/wp0-routing-policy.json \
            | tar -xf - -C "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}"
          for repo_path in \
            tools/layered-ci/select-wp0-route.js \
            tools/layered-ci/wp0-routing.js \
            tools/layered-ci/cli-support.js \
            governance/layered-ci/wp0-routing-policy.json
          do
            expected_blob="$(git rev-parse "${BASE_SHA}:${repo_path}")"
            actual_blob="$(git hash-object "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}/${repo_path}")"
            test "${actual_blob}" = "${expected_blob}"
          done
          git_dir="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)"
          printf 'gitdir: %s\n' "${git_dir}" > "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}/.git"
          git -C "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}" cat-file -e "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}"
          printf 'TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT=%s\n' "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Classify protected WP0 route from base-owned policy
        id: route
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.base }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.range.outputs.head }}
        run: >-
          node "${TRUSTED_ROUTE_POLICY_ROOT}/tools/layered-ci/select-wp0-route.js"
          --base "${BASE_SHA}"
          --head "${HEAD_SHA}"

  wp0-product:
    name: wp0-product
    if: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.route == 'PRODUCT_WP0' }}
    needs: wp0-route
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.base }}
      YANCE_EVALUATED_REPOSITORY_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout reviewed product source head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Establish exact candidate and base-owned policy roots
        shell: bash
        env:
          TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/yance-wp0-trusted-policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git cat-file -e "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}^{commit}"
          test "$(git rev-parse "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}^{commit}")" = "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}" "${REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA}"
          git cat-file -e "${BASELINE_ANCHOR_COMMIT}^{commit}"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "${BASELINE_ANCHOR_COMMIT}" "${REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA}"
          test "$(git rev-parse "${BASELINE_ANCHOR_COMMIT}:${BASELINE_ANCHOR_PATH}")" = "${BASELINE_ANCHOR_BLOB}"
          git switch --force-create "${IMPLEMENTATION_BRANCH}" "${REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA}"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA}"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/${IMPLEMENTATION_BRANCH})"
          rm -rf "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}"
          git worktree prune
          git worktree add --detach --no-checkout "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}" "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}"
          git -C "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}" sparse-checkout init --cone
          git -C "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}" sparse-checkout set tools/wp0 shared/release governance
          git -C "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}" reset --hard "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}"
          test "$(git -C "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}" rev-parse HEAD)" = "${TRUSTED_POLICY_SHA}"
          test -f "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}/tools/wp0/verify-gate.js"
          test -f "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}/shared/release/implementationBranchPolicy.js"
          test -d "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}/governance"
          test ! -e "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}/vendor/electron/electron-v39.8.5-win32-x64.zip"
          printf 'TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT=%s\n' "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Materialize and verify official Electron Release asset
        shell: bash
        env:
          ELECTRON_TRUST_PATH: release/electron-distribution-trust.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -t electron_trust < <(node - <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const trust = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.ELECTRON_TRUST_PATH, 'utf8'));
          const archive = trust.archives?.['win32-x64'];
          const expectedUrl = 'https://github.com/electron/electron/releases/download/v43.4.1/electron-v43.4.1-win32-x64.zip';
          if (trust.electronVersion !== '43.4.1'
            || archive?.fileName !== 'electron-v43.4.1-win32-x64.zip'
            || archive?.sha256 !== 'c2ef9a5f65472c34d14bd3e67b7d14e66b0c01f124aba45263d6a4232160e13a'
            || archive?.sizeBytes !== 150154788
            || archive?.sourceRepository !== 'electron/electron'
            || archive?.releaseTag !== 'v43.4.1'
            || archive?.assetId !== 520075991
            || archive?.downloadUrl !== expectedUrl) {
            throw new Error('Electron official Release trust authority mismatch');
          }
          process.stdout.write([archive.downloadUrl, archive.sha256, String(archive.sizeBytes), archive.fileName].join('\n') + '\n');
          NODE
          )
          test "${#electron_trust[@]}" -eq 4
          electron_archive="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${electron_trust[3]}"
          rm -f "${electron_archive}"
          curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --output "${electron_archive}" "${electron_trust[0]}"
          echo "${electron_trust[1]}  ${electron_archive}" | sha256sum --check --strict
          test "$(stat --format='%s' "${electron_archive}")" = "${electron_trust[2]}"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Run WP0 required tests
        run: npm run test:wp0
      - name: Run staged-secret scanner regressions
        run: npm run test:security-scan
      - name: Run source identity and Electron tracking regressions
        run: >-
          node --test --test-concurrency=1
          tests/runtime-delivery/electron-archive-tracking-authority.test.js
          tests/runtime-delivery/repository-source-identity-authority.test.js
          tests/runtime-delivery/fix6f-source-uat-isolation.test.js
      - name: Validate repository protocol descriptor
        run: node tools/protocol/validate-v3-protocols.js
      - name: Run base-owned executable WP0 gate
        run: >-
          node "${TRUSTED_POLICY_ROOT}/tools/wp0/verify-gate.js"
          --branch "${IMPLEMENTATION_BRANCH}"

  wp0-product-documentation:
    name: wp0-product-documentation
    if: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.route == 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENTATION_WP0' }}
    needs: wp0-route
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - name: Checkout reviewed product documentation head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Verify exact non-executable product documentation diff
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.base }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.head }}
        run: node tools/layered-ci/verify-product-documentation.js --base "${BASE_SHA}" --head "${HEAD_SHA}"
      - name: Run documentation routing contracts
        run: >-
          node --test --test-concurrency=1
          tests/layered-ci/cli-support.test.js
          tests/layered-ci/product-documentation.test.js
          tests/layered-ci/wp0-routing.test.js
      - name: Run staged-secret scanner regressions
        run: npm run test:security-scan
      - name: Validate repository protocol descriptor
        run: node tools/protocol/validate-v3-protocols.js

  wp0-governance:
    name: wp0-governance
    if: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.route == 'GOVERNANCE_WP0' }}
    needs: wp0-route
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout reviewed governance head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Run layered governance contracts
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/layered-ci/*.test.js
      - name: Run generic open-source authorization contracts
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/wp0/open-source-work-package-authorization.test.js
      - name: Run implementation branch policy contract
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/wp0/implementation-branch-policy.test.js
      - name: Run base-owned evaluated repository root contract
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/wp0/base-owned-evaluated-repository-root.test.js
      - name: Enforce OSS-first development admission
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/wp0/oss-first-development-policy.test.js
      - name: Run independent review contract
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/independent-review/chatgpt-review-contract.test.js
      - name: Run staged-secret scanner regressions
        run: npm run test:security-scan
      - name: Validate repository protocol descriptor
        run: node tools/protocol/validate-v3-protocols.js

  wp0-gates:
    name: wp0-gates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs:
      - wp0-route
      - wp0-product
      - wp0-product-documentation
      - wp0-governance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    steps:
      - name: Enforce selected WP0 route result
        shell: bash
        env:
          ROUTE: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.route }}
          ROUTE_RESULT: ${{ needs.wp0-route.result }}
          PRODUCT_RESULT: ${{ needs.wp0-product.result }}
          DOCUMENTATION_RESULT: ${{ needs.wp0-product-documentation.result }}
          GOVERNANCE_RESULT: ${{ needs.wp0-governance.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${ROUTE_RESULT}" = "success"
          case "${ROUTE}" in
            PRODUCT_WP0)
              test "${PRODUCT_RESULT}" = "success"
              test "${DOCUMENTATION_RESULT}" = "skipped"
              test "${GOVERNANCE_RESULT}" = "skipped"
              ;;
            PRODUCT_DOCUMENTATION_WP0)
              test "${PRODUCT_RESULT}" = "skipped"
              test "${DOCUMENTATION_RESULT}" = "success"
              test "${GOVERNANCE_RESULT}" = "skipped"
              ;;
            GOVERNANCE_WP0)
              test "${PRODUCT_RESULT}" = "skipped"
              test "${DOCUMENTATION_RESULT}" = "skipped"
              test "${GOVERNANCE_RESULT}" = "success"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "unknown fail-closed WP0 route: ${ROUTE}" >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

  sealed-export-platform-matrix:
    name: sealed-export-${{ matrix.os }}
    if: ${{ needs.wp0-route.outputs.route == 'PRODUCT_WP0' }}
    needs: wp0-route
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 8
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout reviewed source head
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.REVIEWED_HEAD_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          fetch-tags: false
          lfs: false
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Run sealed export canonical path regressions
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/runtime-delivery/repository-source-identity-authority.test.js

.github/workflows/v21-product-experience.content:
name: V21 Product Experience Shell P0 Final Validation

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PRODUCT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}

jobs:
  frozen-element-reproducibility:
    if: >-
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      (
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-experience-shell-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-experience-bilingual-search-translation-task-ux-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-prelaunch-relationship-tool-portal-route-closure-successor-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-prelaunch-dating-ai-experience-amendment-wp1' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-prelaunch-dating-ai-experience-amendment-wp1-v3' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0-amendment-1-v2' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0-amendment-2' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-system-settings-reachability-p1-successor-v2-amendment-1'
      )
    runs-on: windows-latest
    env:
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      CANDIDATE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
      ELEMENT_COMMIT: a2a996ae50d802878bf48e4bbf3730004bdcc55c
      PNPM_VERSION: 11.5.2
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact reviewed Product candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up pinned Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Verify exact candidate identity and local branch binding
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $actual = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -ne $env:CANDIDATE_SHA) { throw "candidate SHA mismatch: expected=$env:CANDIDATE_SHA actual=$actual" }
          if ($env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH -ne $env:PRODUCT_BRANCH) { throw "unexpected candidate branch: $env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH" }
          git switch --force-create $env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH $env:CANDIDATE_SHA
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to bind exact candidate to local Product branch' }
          if ((git rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -ne $env:CANDIDATE_SHA) { throw 'local Product branch does not point at exact candidate SHA' }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'candidate working tree must be clean before validation' }

      - name: Activate exact pnpm toolchain
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          corepack enable
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'corepack enable failed' }
          corepack prepare pnpm@11.5.2 --activate
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to activate pnpm 11.5.2' }
          Push-Location $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          try { $actualPnpm = (pnpm --version).Trim() } finally { Pop-Location }
          if ($actualPnpm -ne $env:PNPM_VERSION) { throw "pnpm version mismatch: expected=$env:PNPM_VERSION actual=$actualPnpm" }

      - name: Run two clean frozen Element materializations and builds
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $results = @()
          foreach ($iteration in 1..2) {
            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue services/matrix/.runtime
            $pnpmStore = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "product-experience-pnpm-store-$iteration"
            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $pnpmStore
            node tools/matrix/bootstrap.js
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Element materialization failed on iteration $iteration" }

            $element = (Resolve-Path services/matrix/.runtime/element-web).Path
            $actualElementCommit = (git -C $element rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
            if ($actualElementCommit -ne $env:ELEMENT_COMMIT) { throw "Element pin mismatch on iteration ${iteration}: expected=$env:ELEMENT_COMMIT actual=$actualElementCommit" }
            if (-not (Select-String -Path "$element\pnpm-lock.yaml" -Pattern 'modules/yance' -Quiet)) { throw "0011 Product dependency lock importer missing on iteration $iteration" }
            if (-not (Select-String -Path "$element\apps\web\Dockerfile" -Pattern 'nx build yance-element-module' -Quiet)) { throw "0012 module delivery Docker build seam missing on iteration $iteration" }
            if (-not (Select-String -Path "$element\apps\web\Dockerfile" -Pattern '/modules/yance/package.json' -Quiet)) { throw "0012 module manifest delivery seam missing on iteration $iteration" }

            Push-Location $env:RUNNER_TEMP
            try {
              pnpm --dir $element install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir $pnpmStore
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "frozen pnpm install failed on iteration $iteration" }
              pnpm --dir $element exec nx build yance-element-module
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Yance Element module build failed on iteration $iteration" }
              pnpm --dir $element exec nx run yance-element-module:lint:types
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Yance Element module typecheck failed on iteration $iteration" }
            } finally { Pop-Location }
            if (-not (Test-Path "$element\modules\yance\lib\index.js")) { throw "Yance Element module output missing on iteration $iteration" }

            $results += [pscustomobject]@{
              iteration = $iteration
              elementCommit = $actualElementCommit
              pnpmVersion = $env:PNPM_VERSION
              lockSha256 = (Get-FileHash "$element\pnpm-lock.yaml" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
              packageSha256 = (Get-FileHash "$element\modules\yance\package.json" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
          }

          if ($results.Count -ne 2) { throw 'expected exactly two frozen materialization results' }
          if ($results[0].lockSha256 -ne $results[1].lockSha256 -or $results[0].packageSha256 -ne $results[1].packageSha256) {
            throw "reproducibility mismatch: first=$($results[0] | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) second=$($results[1] | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"
          }

          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue services/matrix/.runtime
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'Task 9 validation must leave the candidate working tree clean' }
          $candidateTree = (git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}').Trim()
          Write-Host "GREEN: Task 9 reproducibility bound to $env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH / $env:CANDIDATE_SHA / $candidateTree"

  materialized-desktop-uat:
    if: >-
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      (
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-experience-shell-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-experience-bilingual-search-translation-task-ux-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-prelaunch-relationship-tool-portal-route-closure-successor-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-prelaunch-dating-ai-experience-amendment-wp1' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-prelaunch-dating-ai-experience-amendment-wp1-v3' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0-amendment-1-v2' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0-amendment-2' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-system-settings-reachability-p1-successor-v2-amendment-1'
      )
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      CANDIDATE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
      NODE_ARCHIVE: node-v22.23.1-win-x64.zip
      NODE_ARCHIVE_SHA256: 7df0bc9375723f4a86b3aa1b7cc73342423d9677a8df4538aca31a049e309c29
      NODE_EXE_SHA256: f8d162c0641dcee512132f3bcf8a68169c7ecb852efd8e1a46c9fec5a0f469ed
      RCEDIT_SHA256: 3e7801db1a5edbec91b49a24a094aad776cb4515488ea5a4ca2289c400eade2a
      ELEMENT_COMMIT: a2a996ae50d802878bf48e4bbf3730004bdcc55c
      PNPM_VERSION: 11.5.2
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact reviewed Product candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: false

      - name: Set up trusted-CI Builder host Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Bind exact Product identity
        id: identity
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ((node --version).Trim() -ne 'v22.23.1') { throw "unexpected Builder-host Node: $(node --version)" }
          $builderHostNpm = (npm --version).Trim()
          Write-Host "Builder-host npm $builderHostNpm is bootstrap-only; repository dependency authority is npm@10.9.2"
          $actual = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -ne $env:CANDIDATE_SHA) { throw "candidate SHA mismatch: $actual" }
          git switch --force-create $env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH $env:CANDIDATE_SHA
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to bind local Product branch' }
          $tree = (git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}').Trim()
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'desktop materialization source must start clean' }
          "tree=$tree" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize and verify official Windows Electron Release asset
        id: electron
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $trustPath = 'release/electron-distribution-trust.json'
          $trust = Get-Content -LiteralPath $trustPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $archive = $trust.archives.'win32-x64'
          $expectedUrl = 'https://github.com/electron/electron/releases/download/v43.4.1/electron-v43.4.1-win32-x64.zip'
          if ([string]$trust.electronVersion -ne '43.4.1') { throw "unexpected Electron trust version: $($trust.electronVersion)" }
          if (-not $archive -or [string]$archive.fileName -ne 'electron-v43.4.1-win32-x64.zip') { throw "missing exact win32-x64 Electron Release trust record: $trustPath" }
          if ([string]$archive.sourceRepository -ne 'electron/electron') { throw "unexpected Electron source repository: $($archive.sourceRepository)" }
          if ([string]$archive.releaseTag -ne 'v43.4.1') { throw "unexpected Electron release tag: $($archive.releaseTag)" }
          if ([int64]$archive.assetId -ne 520075991) { throw "unexpected Electron release asset id: $($archive.assetId)" }
          if ([string]$archive.downloadUrl -ne $expectedUrl) { throw "unexpected Electron Release URL: $($archive.downloadUrl)" }
          if ([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName([string]$archive.fileName) -ne [string]$archive.fileName) { throw 'Electron trust fileName must be a basename' }

          $expectedSha256 = ([string]$archive.sha256).ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($expectedSha256 -ne 'c2ef9a5f65472c34d14bd3e67b7d14e66b0c01f124aba45263d6a4232160e13a') { throw "unexpected Electron trust SHA-256: $expectedSha256" }
          if ($expectedSha256 -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw 'Electron trust SHA-256 is malformed' }
          $expectedSize = [int64]$archive.sizeBytes
          if ($expectedSize -ne 150154788) { throw "unexpected Electron Release asset size: $expectedSize" }

          $archivePath = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ([string]$archive.fileName)
          Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archivePath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          & curl.exe --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --output $archivePath ([string]$archive.downloadUrl)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "official Electron Release download failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }

          $actualSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $archivePath).Length
          if ($actualSize -ne $expectedSize) { throw "Electron Release size mismatch: expected=$expectedSize actual=$actualSize" }
          $actualSha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archivePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($actualSha256 -ne $expectedSha256) { throw "Electron Release SHA-256 mismatch: expected=$expectedSha256 actual=$actualSha256" }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'Electron Release materialization must leave the candidate working tree clean' }

          $dist = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-electron-dist'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $dist
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archivePath -DestinationPath $dist
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dist 'electron.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'official Electron distribution did not materialize electron.exe' }
          "archive=$archivePath" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append
          "dist=$dist" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize exact isolated Electron npm trust metadata
        id: electron_npm
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $trust = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'release/electron-distribution-trust.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $lock = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'package-lock.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashTable
          $locked = $lock['packages']['node_modules/electron']
          if (-not $locked -or -not $locked.version -or -not $locked.integrity) { throw 'package-lock Electron record is missing version/integrity' }
          $version = [string]$locked.version
          $expectedIntegrity = [string]$locked.integrity
          if ($version -ne [string]$trust.electronVersion) { throw "Electron lock/trust version mismatch: lock=$version trust=$($trust.electronVersion)" }
          if ($expectedIntegrity -ne [string]$trust.npmPackageIntegrity) { throw 'Electron lock/trust npm integrity mismatch' }
          if ($expectedIntegrity -notmatch '^sha512-[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$') { throw 'Electron npm package integrity must be canonical sha512 SRI' }
          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'node_modules\electron') { throw 'repository-root Electron installation is forbidden for Product Final' }

          $packRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-electron-npm-pack'
          $extractRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-electron-npm-package'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $packRoot, $extractRoot
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $packRoot, $extractRoot | Out-Null

          Push-Location $packRoot
          try {
            npm.cmd exec --yes --package=npm@10.9.2 -- npm pack "electron@$version" --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination $packRoot | Out-Host
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "trusted-CI exact npm@10.9.2 Electron npm pack failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          } finally { Pop-Location }

          $tarballs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $packRoot -Filter '*.tgz' -File)
          if ($tarballs.Count -ne 1) { throw "expected exactly one Electron npm tarball, found $($tarballs.Count)" }
          $tarball = $tarballs[0].FullName
          $sha512 = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA512]::Create()
          $stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($tarball)
          try { $hashBytes = $sha512.ComputeHash($stream) } finally { $stream.Dispose(); $sha512.Dispose() }
          $actualIntegrity = 'sha512-' + [Convert]::ToBase64String($hashBytes)
          if ($actualIntegrity -ne $expectedIntegrity) { throw "Electron npm tarball integrity mismatch: expected=$expectedIntegrity actual=$actualIntegrity" }

          tar.exe -xzf $tarball -C $extractRoot
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Electron npm tarball extraction failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $packageRoot = Join-Path $extractRoot 'package'
          $packageJsonPath = Join-Path $packageRoot 'package.json'
          $checksumsPath = Join-Path $packageRoot 'checksums.json'
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $packageJsonPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'isolated Electron npm package.json is missing' }
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $checksumsPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'isolated Electron npm checksums.json is missing' }
          $packageJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath $packageJsonPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ([string]$packageJson.name -ne 'electron' -or [string]$packageJson.version -ne $version) { throw "isolated Electron npm package identity mismatch: $($packageJson.name)@$($packageJson.version)" }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'isolated Electron npm metadata materialization must leave Product source clean' }
          "root=$((Resolve-Path $packageRoot).Path)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize reviewed Windows production dependency closure
        id: production_deps
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $root = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-production-deps'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $root
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null
          Copy-Item package.json, package-lock.json -Destination $root
          Push-Location $root
          try {
            npm.cmd exec --yes --package=npm@10.9.2 -- npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-bin-links --os=win32 --cpu=x64
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "trusted-CI exact npm@10.9.2 production ci failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          } finally { Pop-Location }
          Remove-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'node_modules\.package-lock.json') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'node_modules\electron')) { throw 'production-only dependency closure unexpectedly contains Electron' }
          "node_modules=$((Resolve-Path (Join-Path $root 'node_modules')).Path)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize and verify packaged trusted Node 22.23.1
        id: packaged_node
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $archive = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP $env:NODE_ARCHIVE
          Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.1/$($env:NODE_ARCHIVE)" -OutFile $archive
          if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $env:NODE_ARCHIVE_SHA256) { throw 'trusted Node archive SHA-256 mismatch' }
          $root = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-packaged-node'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $root
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $root
          $nodeExe = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Filter node.exe -File -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
          if (-not $nodeExe) { throw 'trusted packaged node.exe missing' }
          if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $nodeExe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $env:NODE_EXE_SHA256) { throw 'trusted packaged node.exe SHA-256 mismatch' }
          if ((& $nodeExe --version).Trim() -ne 'v22.23.1') { throw 'trusted packaged Node version mismatch' }
          "node_exe=$nodeExe" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize presealed Parlant Windows runtime in trusted CI
        id: parlant
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-parlant-runtime'
          $work = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-parlant-work'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $output, $work
          & tools/parlant/build-windows-runtime.ps1 -OutputRoot $output -SourceRoot (Resolve-Path '.').Path -WorkRoot $work
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Parlant runtime materialization failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $output 'runtime-seal.json') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Parlant runtime seal missing' }
          "root=$output" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize presealed Learning Windows runtime in trusted CI
        id: learning
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $output = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-learning-runtime'
          $work = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-learning-work'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $output, $work
          & tools/learning-growth/build-windows-runtime.ps1 -OutputRoot $output -SourceRoot (Resolve-Path '.').Path -WorkRoot $work
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Learning runtime materialization failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $output 'runtime-seal.json') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Learning runtime seal missing' }
          "root=$output" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize exact trusted rcedit custody input
        id: rcedit
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $relativePath = 'vendor/rcedit/rcedit-v2.0.0-x64.exe'
          $expectedSha256 = $env:RCEDIT_SHA256.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($expectedSha256 -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw 'rcedit expected SHA-256 is malformed' }
          $expectedSize = [int64]1360384

          $trackedBlob = (git rev-parse "HEAD:$relativePath").Trim()
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $trackedBlob -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw "failed to resolve tracked native Git rcedit blob: $relativePath" }
          $worktreeBlob = (git hash-object --no-filters -- $relativePath).Trim()
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $worktreeBlob -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw "failed to hash worktree rcedit bytes: $relativePath" }
          if ($worktreeBlob -ne $trackedBlob) { throw "rcedit tracked/worktree blob mismatch: tracked=$trackedBlob worktree=$worktreeBlob" }

          $path = (Resolve-Path $relativePath).Path
          $actualSize = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $path).Length
          if ($actualSize -ne $expectedSize) { throw "rcedit native Git size mismatch: expected=$expectedSize actual=$actualSize" }
          $actualSha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($actualSha256 -ne $expectedSha256) { throw "rcedit v2.0.0 x64 SHA-256 mismatch: expected=$expectedSha256 actual=$actualSha256" }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'rcedit native Git verification must leave Product source clean' }
          "path=$path" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Materialize exact isolated WP7 archive OSS toolchain
        id: archive_oss
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $root = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-archive-oss'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $root
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'tools/wp7/archive-oss/package.json' -Destination $root
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'tools/wp7/archive-oss/package-lock.json' -Destination $root

          Push-Location $root
          try {
            npm.cmd exec --yes --package=npm@10.9.2 -- npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-bin-links
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "trusted-CI exact npm@10.9.2 archive OSS ci failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          } finally { Pop-Location }

          $nodeModules = Join-Path $root 'node_modules'
          $tarPackagePath = Join-Path $nodeModules 'tar\package.json'
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tarPackagePath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'isolated tar package metadata is missing' }
          $tarPackage = Get-Content -LiteralPath $tarPackagePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ([string]$tarPackage.name -ne 'tar' -or [string]$tarPackage.version -ne '7.5.22') {
            throw "isolated archive OSS identity mismatch: $($tarPackage.name)@$($tarPackage.version)"
          }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'archive OSS materialization must leave Product source clean' }
          "node_modules=$((Resolve-Path $nodeModules).Path)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Run real WP7 node-tar PAX long-path and determinism contract
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          WP7_ARCHIVE_TOOL_NODE_MODULES: ${{ steps.archive_oss.outputs.node_modules }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/wp7/deterministic-tar-gzip.test.js
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "WP7 real node-tar PAX archive contract failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'WP7 archive contract must leave Product source clean' }

      - name: Build existing WP7 PRE_REVIEW_ONLY trusted desktop and seal Product bundle
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $wp7 = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-wp7'
          $bundle = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-experience-materialized-desktop-uat'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $wp7, $bundle
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $wp7, $bundle | Out-Null
          $commitTime = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse((git show -s --format=%cI HEAD)).UtcDateTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ')
          $session = $env:CANDIDATE_SHA.Substring(0, 32)
          node tools/wp7/create-pre-review-trusted-product.js `
            --repo-root (Resolve-Path '.').Path `
            --electron-archive '${{ steps.electron.outputs.archive }}' `
            --electron-dist '${{ steps.electron.outputs.dist }}' `
            --electron-npm-package-root '${{ steps.electron_npm.outputs.root }}' `
            --production-node-modules '${{ steps.production_deps.outputs.node_modules }}' `
            --trusted-node-executable '${{ steps.packaged_node.outputs.node_exe }}' `
            --parlant-runtime '${{ steps.parlant.outputs.root }}' `
            --learning-runtime '${{ steps.learning.outputs.root }}' `
            --rcedit-path '${{ steps.rcedit.outputs.path }}' `
            --archive-tool-node-modules '${{ steps.archive_oss.outputs.node_modules }}' `
            --output-dir $wp7 `
            --build-timestamp-utc $commitTime `
            --build-session-id $session `
            --target-platform win32 `
            --target-arch x64
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "existing WP7 trusted-product builder failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $wp7 'WP7_PRE_REVIEW_TRUSTED_PRODUCT_BUILD.json') -Destination $bundle
          Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $wp7 -Filter 'Yance_Stage6_4_5_9_WP7_PreReview_Trusted_Product_*.tar.gz' -File | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $bundle }
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'tools/product-experience/RUN_PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_MATERIALIZED_UAT.ps1' -Destination $bundle
          node tools/product-experience/create-materialized-uat-candidate.js seal `
            --root $bundle `
            --bundle-class PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_MATERIALIZED_DESKTOP_UAT_ONLY `
            --candidate-branch $env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH `
            --candidate-commit $env:CANDIDATE_SHA `
            --candidate-tree '${{ steps.identity.outputs.tree }}'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'desktop candidate sealing failed' }
          node tools/product-experience/create-materialized-uat-candidate.js verify `
            --root $bundle `
            --bundle-class PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_MATERIALIZED_DESKTOP_UAT_ONLY `
            --candidate-branch $env:CANDIDATE_BRANCH `
            --candidate-commit $env:CANDIDATE_SHA `
            --candidate-tree '${{ steps.identity.outputs.tree }}'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'desktop candidate verification failed' }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'desktop materialization must leave Product source clean' }

      - name: Launch exact packaged Yance against exact Element ModuleLoader path and require fresh PASS receipt
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          YANCE_WP2_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_PROBE: '1'
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $bundle = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-experience-materialized-desktop-uat'
          $archive = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $bundle -Filter 'Yance_Stage6_4_5_9_WP7_PreReview_Trusted_Product_*.tar.gz' -File | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $archive) { throw 'materialized desktop archive is missing before packaged launch validation' }

          $applicationRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-packaged-launch'
          $dataRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-packaged-data'
          $hostRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-element-validation-host'
          $pnpmStore = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'product-uat-element-pnpm-store'
          Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $applicationRoot, $dataRoot, $hostRoot, $pnpmStore, services/matrix/.runtime
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $applicationRoot, $dataRoot, $hostRoot | Out-Null
          tar.exe -xzf $archive.FullName -C $applicationRoot
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "materialized desktop extraction failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
          $yanceExe = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $applicationRoot -Filter 'Yance.exe' -File -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $yanceExe) { throw 'exact packaged Yance.exe is missing after trusted-product extraction' }

          corepack enable
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'corepack enable failed for exact Element host' }
          corepack prepare pnpm@11.5.2 --activate
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to activate pnpm 11.5.2 for exact Element host' }
          node tools/matrix/bootstrap.js
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'exact Element materialization failed for packaged Windows validation' }
          $element = (Resolve-Path services/matrix/.runtime/element-web).Path
          $actualElementCommit = (git -C $element rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actualElementCommit -ne $env:ELEMENT_COMMIT) { throw "Element pin mismatch: expected=$env:ELEMENT_COMMIT actual=$actualElementCommit" }
          if (-not (Select-String -Path "$element\apps\web\Dockerfile" -Pattern 'nx build yance-element-module' -Quiet)) { throw '0012 exact module build seam is missing' }
          if (-not (Select-String -Path "$element\apps\web\Dockerfile" -Pattern '/modules/yance/package.json' -Quiet)) { throw '0012 exact module delivery seam is missing' }

          Push-Location $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          try {
            $pnpmVersionLines = @(pnpm --version)
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "exact Element host pnpm version probe failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }
            $actualPnpm = ($pnpmVersionLines -join "`n").Trim()
            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($actualPnpm)) { throw 'exact Element host pnpm version probe returned no output' }
            if ($actualPnpm -ne $env:PNPM_VERSION) { throw "exact Element host pnpm mismatch: expected=$env:PNPM_VERSION actual=$actualPnpm" }
            pnpm --dir $element install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir $pnpmStore
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'exact Element frozen install failed for packaged Windows validation' }
            pnpm --dir $element exec nx build yance-element-module
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'exact Yance Element module build failed for packaged Windows validation' }
            $env:VERSION = '1.12.25'
            pnpm --dir (Join-Path $element 'apps/web') build
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'exact Element webapp build failed for packaged Windows validation' }
          } finally {
            Remove-Item Env:VERSION -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Pop-Location
          }

          $webapp = Join-Path $element 'apps/web/webapp'
          $modulePackage = Join-Path $element 'modules/yance/package.json'
          $moduleLib = Join-Path $element 'modules/yance/lib'
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $webapp 'index.html') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'exact built Element webapp index is missing' }
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $moduleLib 'index.js') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'exact built Yance Element module entrypoint is missing' }
          Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $webapp '*') -Destination $hostRoot -Recurse -Force
          $servedModuleRoot = Join-Path $hostRoot 'modules\yance'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $servedModuleRoot | Out-Null
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath $modulePackage -Destination (Join-Path $servedModuleRoot 'package.json') -Force
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath $moduleLib -Destination $servedModuleRoot -Recurse -Force

          $config = Get-Content -LiteralPath 'config/matrix/element-config.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $config | Add-Member -NotePropertyName modules -NotePropertyValue @('/modules/yance/lib/index.js') -Force
          $config | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $hostRoot 'config.json') -Encoding UTF8

          $server = @'
          const http = require('http');
          const fs = require('fs');
          const path = require('path');
          const root = path.resolve(process.argv[2]);
          const types = new Map([
            ['.html', 'text/html; charset=utf-8'], ['.js', 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8'], ['.mjs', 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8'],
            ['.json', 'application/json; charset=utf-8'], ['.css', 'text/css; charset=utf-8'], ['.svg', 'image/svg+xml'],
            ['.png', 'image/png'], ['.jpg', 'image/jpeg'], ['.jpeg', 'image/jpeg'], ['.gif', 'image/gif'], ['.webp', 'image/webp'],
            ['.woff', 'font/woff'], ['.woff2', 'font/woff2'], ['.wasm', 'application/wasm'], ['.map', 'application/json; charset=utf-8']
          ]);
          function resolveRequest(url) {
            const pathname = decodeURIComponent(String(url || '/').split('?')[0]).replace(/\\/g, '/');
            const relative = pathname === '/' ? 'index.html' : pathname.replace(/^\/+/, '');
            const candidate = path.resolve(root, relative);
            if (candidate !== root && !candidate.startsWith(root + path.sep)) return null;
            return candidate;
          }
          const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
            let file = resolveRequest(req.url);
            if (!file) { res.writeHead(400); res.end('bad request'); return; }
            try {
              if (fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()) file = path.join(file, 'index.html');
            } catch {
              if (!path.extname(file)) file = path.join(root, 'index.html');
            }
            fs.readFile(file, (error, body) => {
              if (error) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('not found'); return; }
              res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': types.get(path.extname(file).toLowerCase()) || 'application/octet-stream', 'content-length': body.length, 'cache-control': 'no-cache' });
              res.end(body);
            });
          });
          server.listen(18080, '127.0.0.1');
          '@
          $serverPath = Join-Path $hostRoot 'server.cjs'
          Set-Content -LiteralPath $serverPath -Value $server -Encoding UTF8
          $hostProcess = Start-Process -FilePath (Get-Command node).Source -ArgumentList @($serverPath, $hostRoot) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden

          $env:YANCE_DATA_DIR = $dataRoot
          $env:YANCE_ELEMENT_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:18080'
          $env:YANCE_ELEMENT_HEALTH_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:18080/config.json'
          $receiptPath = Join-Path $dataRoot 'logs\post-install-launch.json'
          Remove-Item -LiteralPath $receiptPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          $startedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
          $process = $null
          try {
            $hostDeadline = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(20)
            $hostReady = $false
            while ([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow -lt $hostDeadline) {
              try {
                $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $env:YANCE_ELEMENT_HEALTH_URL -TimeoutSec 2
                if ($response.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $response.Content -match 'modules') { $hostReady = $true; break }
              } catch {}
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
            }
            if (-not $hostReady) { throw 'exact built Element validation host did not become ready with runtime module config' }

            $process = Start-Process -FilePath $yanceExe.FullName -ArgumentList '--post-install' -WorkingDirectory $yanceExe.DirectoryName -PassThru
            $deadline = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(120)
            $receipt = $null
            while ([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow -lt $deadline) {
              $process.Refresh()
              if ($process.HasExited) { throw "packaged Yance.exe exited before post-install receipt: exitCode=$($process.ExitCode)" }
              if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $receiptPath -PathType Leaf) {
                $candidateReceipt = Get-Content -LiteralPath $receiptPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
                if ([int]$candidateReceipt.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or [string]$candidateReceipt.documentType -ne 'YANCE_POST_INSTALL_LAUNCH_RECEIPT') { throw 'post-install launch receipt schema mismatch' }
                if ([string]$candidateReceipt.status -ne 'PASS') { throw "post-install launch receipt status is not PASS: $($candidateReceipt.status)" }
                if ([int]$candidateReceipt.processId -ne [int]$process.Id) { throw "post-install receipt process mismatch: expected=$($process.Id) actual=$($candidateReceipt.processId)" }
                $activatedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$candidateReceipt.activatedAtUtc)
                if ($activatedAt -lt $startedAt) { throw 'post-install launch receipt is stale' }
                if ($candidateReceipt.window.destroyed -eq $true -or $candidateReceipt.window.visible -ne $true -or $candidateReceipt.window.minimized -eq $true) { throw 'post-install launch receipt window is not Desktop READY' }
                $receipt = $candidateReceipt
                break
              }
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
            }
            if (-not $receipt) { throw "timed out waiting for fresh post-install-launch.json: $receiptPath" }
            Write-Host "GREEN: exact packaged Yance.exe reached post-install PASS against pinned Element ModuleLoader path with production runtime probe enabled at $($receipt.activatedAtUtc)"
          } finally {
            if ($process) { taskkill.exe /PID $process.Id /T /F 2>$null | Out-Null }
            if ($hostProcess) { Stop-Process -Id $hostProcess.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue services/matrix/.runtime
          }
          if ((git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all).Length -ne 0) { throw 'packaged launch validation must leave Product source clean' }

      - name: Upload packaged startup diagnostics after Product Final RED
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Product-Experience-Packaged-Startup-Diagnostics-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}\product-uat-packaged-data\logs\desktop-bootstrap.jsonl
            ${{ runner.temp }}\product-uat-packaged-data\logs\desktop.jsonl
            ${{ runner.temp }}\product-uat-packaged-data\logs\server.jsonl
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload materialized desktop UAT
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Product-Experience-Materialized-Desktop-UAT-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}\product-experience-materialized-desktop-uat\**
          if-no-files-found: error

  materialized-matrix-uat:
    if: >-

        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'fix/v21-product-experience-windows-uat-startup-p0-amendment-2' ||
        github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'product/v21-product-system-settings-reachability-p1-successor-v2-amendment-1'
      )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      CANDIDATE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact reviewed Product candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up pinned Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.1'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Bind exact Product identity
        id: identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CANDIDATE_SHA"
          test "$CANDIDATE_BRANCH" = "$PRODUCT_BRANCH"
          git switch --force-create "$CANDIDATE_BRANCH" "$CANDIDATE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
          echo "tree=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Materialize pinned Matrix sources and build exact candidate images
        shell: bash
        run: |

          rm -rf services/matrix/.runtime
          ambient_core_autocrlf_before="$(git config --show-origin --get-all core.autocrlf || true)"

          ambient_core_autocrlf_after="$(git config --show-origin --get-all core.autocrlf || true)"

          docker build --tag "yance-product-uat-mautrix-whatsapp:${CANDIDATE_SHA}" services/matrix/.runtime/mautrix-whatsapp

          bundle="$RUNNER_TEMP/product-experience-materialized-matrix-uat"

            "yance-product-uat-synapse:${CANDIDATE_SHA}" \
            "yance-product-uat-element:${CANDIDATE_SHA}" \
            "yance-product-uat-mautrix-whatsapp:${CANDIDATE_SHA}"

          cp config/matrix/element-config.json "$bundle/matrix-config/element-config.json"
          cp config/matrix/mautrix-whatsapp/config.yaml "$bundle/matrix-config/mautrix-whatsapp/config.yaml"

            --candidate-branch "$CANDIDATE_BRANCH" \
            --candidate-commit "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \

            --root "$bundle" \
            --bundle-class PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_MATERIALIZED_MATRIX_UAT_ONLY \
            --candidate-branch "$CANDIDATE_BRANCH" \
            --candidate-commit "$CANDIDATE_SHA" \
            --candidate-tree '${{ steps.identity.outputs.tree }}'
          rm -rf services/matrix/.runtime
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"

      - name: Upload materialized Matrix UAT
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: Product-Experience-Materialized-Matrix-UAT-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/product-experience-materialized-matrix-uat/**
          if-no-files-found: error

.github/workflows/windows-production-rel.content:
name: Yance Windows Release (Deferred Public Publishing)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source_ref:
        description: Exact release branch, tag, or commit to build
        required: true
        default: rebuild/windows-release-closure-20260715-release-branding-autoupdate
      expected_commit:
        description: Exact reviewed 40-character source commit
        required: true
      expected_tree:
        description: Exact reviewed 40-character source tree
        required: true
      publish:
        description: "Deferred: publish assets to a future trusted Yance-Releases repository"
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: 22.16.0
  ELECTRON_VERSION: 43.4.1
  ELECTRON_ARCHIVE_SHA256: c2ef9a5f65472c34d14bd3e67b7d14e66b0c01f124aba45263d6a4232160e13a
  RELEASE_REPOSITORY: wangyi198675-coder/Yance-Releases

jobs:
  signed-windows-release:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - name: Configure deterministic Git line endings
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.eol lf

      - name: Checkout exact source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Set up reviewed Node runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Verify source and release identity
        id: identity
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          EXPECTED_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.expected_commit }}
          EXPECTED_TREE: ${{ inputs.expected_tree }}
          REQUESTED_SOURCE_REF: ${{ inputs.source_ref }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          foreach ($pair in @(@('commit',$env:EXPECTED_COMMIT), @('tree',$env:EXPECTED_TREE))) {
            if ($pair[1] -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw "expected $($pair[0]) must be a lowercase 40-character Git object ID" }
          }
          $actualCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          $actualTree = (git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}').Trim()
          if ($actualCommit -ne $env:EXPECTED_COMMIT) { throw "source commit mismatch: $actualCommit" }
          if ($actualTree -ne $env:EXPECTED_TREE) { throw "source tree mismatch: $actualTree" }
          $buildBranch = "release-candidate-$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID-$env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          git switch --create $buildBranch
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to create the isolated release candidate branch' }
          $dirty = @(git status --porcelain)
          if ($dirty.Count -ne 0) { throw 'release checkout is not clean' }
          $node = (node --version).Trim()
          if ($node -ne 'v22.16.0') { throw "unexpected Node runtime: $node" }
          "commit=$actualCommit" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append
          "tree=$actualTree" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append
          "branch=$buildBranch" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append
          "requested_ref=$env:REQUESTED_SOURCE_REF" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Install reviewed dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Run source and pre-review gates
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node tools/verify-source-regressions.js
          npm run verify:wp0
          npm run test:wp7

      - name: Prepare externally approved packaging inputs
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_BASE64: ${{ secrets.WP7_PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_BASE64 }}
          PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256: ${{ secrets.WP7_PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256 }}
          SIGNING_PFX_BASE64: ${{ secrets.WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PFX_BASE64 }}
          YANCE_WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          foreach ($name in @('PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_BASE64','PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256','SIGNING_PFX_BASE64','YANCE_WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD')) {
            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace((Get-Item "Env:$name").Value)) { throw "required release secret is missing: $name" }
          }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input -Force | Out-Null
          [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes("$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\preacceptance.json", [Convert]::FromBase64String($env:PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_BASE64))
          [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes("$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\windows-signing.pfx", [Convert]::FromBase64String($env:SIGNING_PFX_BASE64))
          $actual = (Get-FileHash "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\preacceptance.json" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($actual -ne $env:PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256.ToLowerInvariant()) { throw 'preacceptance record SHA256 mismatch' }

      - name: Download and verify official Electron archive
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $archive = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\electron-v${env:ELECTRON_VERSION}-win32-x64.zip"
          Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/electron/electron/releases/download/v${env:ELECTRON_VERSION}/electron-v${env:ELECTRON_VERSION}-win32-x64.zip" -OutFile $archive
          $actual = (Get-FileHash $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($actual -ne $env:ELECTRON_ARCHIVE_SHA256) { throw "Electron archive SHA256 mismatch: $actual" }

      - name: Locate native build tools
        id: tools
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $makensis = @(
            'C:\Program Files (x86)\NSIS\makensis.exe',
            'C:\Program Files\NSIS\makensis.exe'
          ) | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $makensis) { throw 'native makensis.exe is not installed on this runner' }
          $signtool = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\*\x64\signtool.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
          if (-not $signtool) { throw 'x64 signtool.exe is not installed on this runner' }
          "makensis=$makensis" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append
          "signtool=$signtool" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append

      - name: Create immutable source bundle
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $branch = '${{ steps.identity.outputs.branch }}'
          git bundle create "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\source.bundle" "refs/heads/$branch"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'source bundle creation failed' }
          git bundle verify "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\source.bundle"

      - name: Build and sign release before metadata sealing
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          YANCE_WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WINDOWS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256: ${{ secrets.WP7_PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256 }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $timestamp = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ')
          & tools/wp7/RUN_WINDOWS_FINAL_BUILDER.ps1 `
            -SourceBundle "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\source.bundle" `
            -WorkRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-work" `
            -EvidenceRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-evidence" `
            -PreacceptanceRecord "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\preacceptance.json" `
            -PreacceptanceSha256 $env:PREACCEPTANCE_RECORD_SHA256 `
            -ElectronArchive "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\electron-v${env:ELECTRON_VERSION}-win32-x64.zip" `
            -MakensisPath '${{ steps.tools.outputs.makensis }}' `
            -ExpectedCommit '${{ steps.identity.outputs.commit }}' `
            -ExpectedTree '${{ steps.identity.outputs.tree }}' `
            -ExpectedBranch '${{ steps.identity.outputs.branch }}' `
            -BuildTimestampUtc $timestamp `
            -RequireSignedInstaller `
            -SigningCertificate "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-input\windows-signing.pfx" `
            -SignToolPath '${{ steps.tools.outputs.signtool }}'

      - name: Verify signed release assets
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $output = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-evidence\builder-output"
          $builder = Get-Content "$output\builder-result.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($builder.status -ne 'PASS' -or $builder.authenticodeStatus -ne 'Valid') { throw 'signed Builder result is not valid' }
          $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -FilePath $builder.installerFile
          if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid') { throw "installer signature status: $($signature.Status)" }
          foreach ($asset in @($builder.installerFile,$builder.latestYmlFile,$builder.blockmapFile,$builder.releaseEvidenceFile,"$output\build-session-seal.json")) {
            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $asset -PathType Leaf)) { throw "release asset missing: $asset" }
          }

      - name: Upload signed release evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: yance-signed-windows-release
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}\yance-release-evidence\**
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Verify public signed release policy
        if: ${{ inputs.publish }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $source = Get-Content release/release-source.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $policy = Get-Content governance/stage-policy.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($source.distributionMode -ne 'PUBLIC_SIGNED_AUTOUPDATE') { throw 'release source is not authorized for public signed auto-update distribution' }
          if ($policy.distributionMode -ne $source.distributionMode -or $policy.publicRelease -ne $true -or $policy.authenticodeRequired -ne $true -or $policy.unknownPublisherAccepted -ne $false) {
            throw 'stage policy does not authorize public signed release publishing'
          }

      - name: Publish trusted update release
        if: ${{ inputs.publish }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.YANCE_RELEASES_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:GH_TOKEN)) { throw 'YANCE_RELEASES_TOKEN is required to publish' }
          $source = Get-Content release/release-source.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $output = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\yance-release-evidence\builder-output"
          $builder = Get-Content "$output\builder-result.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $tag = "v$($source.productVersion)"
          $title = "$($source.publicProductName) / $($source.publicProductNameEnglish) $($source.publicVersion)"
          $notes = "Signed Windows release for $title. Technical update version: $($source.productVersion)."
          gh release create $tag --repo $env:RELEASE_REPOSITORY --title $title --notes $notes `
            $builder.installerFile $builder.latestYmlFile $builder.blockmapFile $builder.releaseEvidenceFile "$output\build-session-seal.json" "$output\builder-result.json"
